task.title: Make the task registry independent of locale encoding
task.problem: Registry index Unicode fails under an ASCII locale.
task.proposal: Use explicit UTF-8 reads/writes and test check/render with UTF-8 mode and locale coercion disabled.
acceptance: check/render/check succeeds with LC_ALL=C, PYTHONUTF8=0 and PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0.
evidence: Delivered in merged PR #1 at cd94684843afee7a56eb148aa9de07b6b54c684e.
